entity.prototype_role: herbaceous perennial native to western North America (BC interior grasslands); 1 survey mention for long bloom — tests a dry-site native used outside its native range on the coast; origin_status provisional (E-Flora claim decides)

notes: origin_status native_north_america kept (2026-11-02): E-Flora BC — native (Yellow, S5) but common only in south-central / south-east BC and INTRODUCED in the lower Fraser Valley; no CWH or CDF stations. A Vancouver planting uses it outside its native range.

taxonomic_identity.note: Gaillardia aristata Pursh; the garden hybrid G. × grandiflora is a different taxon and was not used

geographic_origin.note: native to BC's interior (E-Flora Yellow S5; IDF / PP / BG stations, none in CWH or CDF) and INTRODUCED in the lower Fraser Valley (E-Flora); USDA / MOBOT 'native' at continental scale. origin_status native_north_america kept; 'native' as a Vancouver selection reason is not supported by the BC source

botanical_growth_form.note: read as herbaceous_perennial from kpu (entity.kpu_plant_type), eflora (supported; M29a)

design_function.note: perennial border / wildflower garden (RHS, MOBOT); respondent 'long blooming flower'

not_available.gpp: no Great Plant Picks entry: the full GPP list (1,129 plants, alphabetical, pages 1–3) has no Gaillardia between Fatsia and Galanthus; name search 'Gaillardia' returned the unfiltered list (checked 2026-11-02)
not_available.osu: no Oregon State University Landscape Plants entry: the site is 'mostly woody' and its G genus index (Garrya … Gymnocladus) has no Gaillardia; /plants/gaillardia-aristata and /plants/gaillardia-x-grandiflora both return 404 (checked 2026-11-02)
not_available.mobot_cultivars: MOBOT also lists Gaillardia aristata 'Bijou' (taxonid 249992) and BARBICAN YELLOW RED RING (445827), plus G. × grandiflora (263710) and cultivars; not extracted — species page only
not_available.rhs_cultivars: RHS also has G. aristata 'Maxima Aurea' (152412), 'Lucky Wheeler' (333428), 'Gaiz0005' (357631) and many G. × grandiflora pages; only the species page (67388) extracted
not_available.usda_plant_guide: USDA NRCS Plant Guide pg_gaar.pdf exists (public domain) but was not read — the brief limits USDA extraction to the PLANTS API profile and characteristics
not_available.kpu: KPU plant database lists only 'Gaillardia cvs.' (/Plant/gagr), no species page; tier C, link only
